title: pilosella floribunda subsp. atrocrocea
intro: Pilosella floribunda subsp. atrocrocea, commonly known as the bitter fleabane, is a plant species in the dandelion family that is native to Europe. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from various health issues such as digestive problems and inflammation, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella floribunda subsp. atrocrocea include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. The exact bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but studies suggest that it may have potential in the development of new medications due to its therapeutic actions.
